name: TT's Garden Spaghetti
author: TT
steps: Dice the onion. In a large pot, brown the ground turkey with half of the diced onion until fully cooked.
Peel the squash and zucchini, then dice all the vegetables and add them to the pot.
Pour in one cup each of vegetable broth and bone broth, and bring to a simmer until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the grape tomatoes (halved), tomato paste and the ½ cup of marinara sauce (or more to taste if you prefer), and let it cook for a few more minutes.
In a separate pot, boil the spiral noodles according to the package instructions.
Once everything is done, combine the cooked noodles with the vegetable and turkey mixture.
Sprinkle with shredded mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, and season with ground pepper to taste.
